_note: Sounds the game plays, by moment. Paths are under res://. A file that doesn't exist is simply silent. Volumes are in dB (0 = as recorded, -6 = about half as loud).

build._note: A building without its own sound plays default, the shared construction sound.

ambient._note: Plays under the island view in every phase, and on the title screen. Each loop has a volume when zoomed right out (far_db) and right in (near_db). Calls are single sounds played now and then, a random one each time, every_seconds apart (shortest, longest).

music._note: Not played at present: the island ambience replaced the themes. audio.music(theme) still plays these if called.

_countdown_note: The countdown sound starts this many seconds before the build clock runs out.

theme._note: The music. Each phase asks for a track: main in setup and the build and repair phase, fast once the build clock is under fast_under_seconds, very_fast in targeting, none during the attack. A change fades the old track out over switch_out_seconds, leaves switch_gap_seconds of just the island ambience, then fades the new one in over switch_in_seconds. The main theme picks up where it left off; the others start from the top. The main theme also plays for play_seconds, then rests (silent) for rest_seconds, each picked at random in its range, fading over fade_seconds. glock is not used yet.
theme._note_track_switch: Per-track overrides of the switch timings: the battle theme comes in with the siren at once and fades out slowly once our strikes have landed.

_note_effects_db: effects_db: every sound effect and building sound plays this many dB below its file's level (the click too).

end_videos._note: Full-screen looping video behind the end-of-game box. A file that doesn't exist leaves the map showing instead.
